A warm storybook cartoon illustration for Keywright, a cosy fantasy shop game, based on the approved C2 reference's rounded shapes, warm colours, readable faces and crafted objects, but WITHOUT ANY OUTLINES. Separate shapes with adjacent colour fills and two or three cel-shaded material tones, never inked contour strokes. No black, dark plum or other coloured line tracing around silhouettes or inside shapes; no comic linework, border strokes or dark halos. Natural eyes, small facial features, material seams and cast-shadow areas may stay dark where needed, but never form an encircling stroke. A script makes chunky 4x pixel art afterwards: draw a smooth illustration, not a pixel grid. Keep recognisable, purposeful detail: three or four bold features per figure or object where the small size permits, such as a patch, a seam, a nail head, a tied cord or a carved mark, expressed as filled shapes. Larger scenery can have grouped flowers, fences and signs of daily use at its edges. Preserve broad areas between these features; no all-over speckling, hatching, fine grain or individual hair strands. Keep details broad enough to survive reduction. Use two or three main cel-shaded tones per material and a restrained highlight; distant scenery has softer, lighter colour contrast. Soft, muted, warm colours; shadows lean violet, lights warm yellow, one gentle light from the upper left, neutral daylight. Plain writing areas stay plain. No text, letters, numbers or rune-like marks. Flat pure magenta (#FF00FF) means empty: never use magenta or hot pink in the subject itself.

Reference 1 is the approved category anchor for broad rounded material shapes and calm solid cel-shaded colour ONLY. Draw the NEW specified subject, never copy the anchor's coins, lantern shape, violet flame or palette unless this subject calls for them. Reference 2 is the master palette. One highest-quality PNG, requested size 1024x1024. The finished sprite is only 24x24 native pixels and normally displays at 2x; keep all stated identifying features bold and readable at that size. Fill about ninety percent of the image, with modest pure #ff00ff margin on every side, no cut-off parts. Use only TWO SOLID flat colours per material and at most SIX solid fills overall when possible. No gradients, texture, dithering, grain, tiny dots, narrow edge highlights or little polygonal facets. Broad connected colour fields dominate. The object has real thickness expressed by adjacent filled front/side faces, never enclosing outlines or contour strokes. Glass is an opaque pale blue or violet filled pane with one broad reflection, never transparent magenta showing through the subject. No ground plane, drop shadow, halo, text, lettering, numbers, labels, watermark or extra objects. Pure magenta occupies every empty gap. Metal rims and necessary material seams may be visible as broad material shapes but must not trace every edge.
Edit reference 3 (the current target). Preserve the specified identity, silhouette and signature features; simplify only the following details for the specified native sprite. Retain the pale grand shop, broad red awning and gold crown. Simplify to a single cream main facade and one muted cream side face; no stone joints, column bands or fine step lines. Solid blue panes, no window reflections. Red awning in just two wide colour blocks with no narrow highlight strips. Single broad brown doorway. Crown in one gold fill. NO bevels, small glints or isolated dots. The three identifying features should be large at 24x24.
